notes.title: Hotseat mode, a new event system, Polish language, and many other changes!
notes.notes:
Greetings!

Here is the Revival: Recolonization team! We've prepared a big content update for the game, including releasing the two-player [b]Hotseat mode[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/3df0b3593910943fce82dc4b3d93d4a10a4c4e26.png[/img]

In addition, we've introduced an event system to the game. Events feature unexpected challenges that players must overcome by using one of the unique traits of their faction. By carefully reading the event descriptions, players can strategize and select the trait that aligns best with the situation. Choosing the right trait can lead to valuable bonuses.

When visiting a town or settlement, you can communicate with the assimilated clan.  Notifications about fulfillment and violation of obligations have been added, along with changes to the AI.

We've changed the logic of AI action when attacking foreign regions. The AI returns units from the attack if there is not enough power to win, and it does not attack the city from the sea. The enemy will only attack if there is enough power in the current state, and it is confident of victory. It will no longer allow the player to impose unfavorable exchanges. Fighting the AI has become more interesting and more difficult. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/8765e7142d0e755620cb48bae59c683244d06d19.png[/img]

What else is new: 

[h3][b]Graphics:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New animations of exploding vehicles with towers flying off have been added.
[*] New edict capsule model with new animations and soundtrack.
[*] Flamethrowers now change colors if you change the tank in the ammo cell.
[/list]
[h3][b]Localization:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Polish language added.
[*] Multiple corrections in the texts.
[*] The Stalkers have been renamed the Diggers.
[/list]
[h3][b]Balance:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The global project “Temple of the All-Mother” gives +2 to the population of new cities instead of +1.
[*] Increased the cost of selecting hexes for the Earthquake edict by 2 times, from 75 to 150.
[*] Increased the cost of running Gravity Edicts at the first level from 25 to 50.
[*] The item “Berserker Charm” gives +3 instead of +1 health points on a kill.
[*] The Berserker Rage science bonus gives +3 health points instead of +1 on a kill.
[*] The Rain Edict now destroys roads outside of cities.
[/list]
[h3][b]Interface:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Additional food creation progress has been added to the city panel. It will appear if a new person is expected to arrive in the city on the next turn and there is an excess of food available.
[*] Added buttons to switch between airfields and missile silos.
[*] Added new animations to interface elements.
[*] Added an option to turn the hex grid on and off in the battle panel.
[*] Options to select the number of factions under AI control in the New Game settings.
[*] Added a new tooltip window for rare resources, where you can see what items require the resource.
[*] The faction color selection has been moved under the emissary portrait.
[*] Changed the tooltip window for equipment items. 
[*] Added a declaration of war option to the diplomacy window on the treaties tab instead of the unavailable truce option.
[*] Added new images for the victory and defeat screens.
[*] Added an item-type icon for the scout.
[*] The task window will now be closed when the game loads after turn 10.
[*] The portraits of emissaries and chiefs in the diplomacy window have been moved to the right.
[*] Commitments now show the time remaining.
[*] The commitment tooltip now has a link to the faction and clan.
[*] The trade window near items now displays the value in reputation if a trade deal is made.
[*] Added a “Find Emissary” button.
[/list]
[h3][b]Sound:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Sounds of units taking damage outside of combat now only play if the player can see them.
[*] Fixed missing explosion sounds for grenades.
[/list]
[h3][b]Settings:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added option to reset settings by category or all at once.
[*] Added a hotkey to reset all settings to default (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F10).
[/list]
[h3][b]Fixed bugs:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The hint window did not always appear correctly.
[*] An exploit that allowed you to lead the same clan twice at the beginning of the game, getting twice the number of troops.
[*] A bug that caused the Great Fountain global project to allow a clan with less loyalty to be assimilated even if it was not a faction vassal and had a different nationality.
[*] Incorrect positioning of chieftain avatars in cities and settlement icons on the strategic map during training.
[*] A bug that could cause victory conditions to not work correctly when loading saves.
[*] Notification sounds are now shorter and less significant.
[*] Missing city walls at the start of battle in some cases.
[*] Displayed city walls in the fog of war in some cases.
[*] The altar’s position will now not be revealed when loading a save.
[*] Squads are now not allowed to move through the altar.
[*] The altar is now not visible in the fog of war.
[*] Renamed the map type selection options in the new game settings window for better understanding.
[*] Incorrect loyalty calculation between factions in case one of them has no cities.
[*] Incorrect notifications when units violate the border.
[*] Houses on empty city hexes will now appear without animation when loading the game.
[*] Missing camera focuses on the location of a clan attack on a town. 
[*] Bug that caused the clan leadership window to display a group tooltip window instead of the warrior description window when hovering over a warrior icon.
[*] The Arch of Valor global project now works correctly when a player attacks a city.
[*] The force shield now does not rotate with the squad.
[*] Quarters are now correctly displayed and hidden in the fog of war.
[*] Faction property bonuses do not show the opening of sciences if they are already open.
[*] Added a shield attack for the Electric Shield item.
[*] Incorrect display of nuclear mine and airfield icons in science hints.
[*] Incorrect display of the interface when it is zoomed in, now it cannot be zoomed in. 
[*] Freezing when AI units move through the clan settlement.
[*] Possible errors when combining units. 
[*] Possible errors during the peaceful capture of a city.
[*] Errors in the AI of missile silos and submarines.
[*] A situation in which it was possible to lead someone else's clan.
[*] A bug where two units could be on the same hex.
[*] Other bugs that caused the game to freeze.
[*] Incorrect display of the prediction scale in the battle dialog. 
[*] Information in the squad hint window when hovering the mouse over a zombie.
[*] Trade deals now display the correct duration in turns (25 turns) when trading with a clan. 
[*] Error in predicting damage received when hovering the mouse over an enemy.
[*] Now, resources received by trade are always displayed on the right, and resources traded away are always displayed on the left.
[*] The bottom right panel now shows a valid emissary portrait. 
[/list]
We hope you enjoy the game and this update! Share your impressions with us here or on [url=https://discord.gg/2WfSpKYwd7]Discord[/url]. 

Regards,
Revival: Recolonization Team

notes.title: Hotfix! Fixed game freezing bugs and some more
notes.notes:
Greetings!

There were a few bugs found in the latest version of the game. Thank you for reporting them. We've already made a few fixes.

Fixed:
[olist]
[*] A bug that caused the tooltip describing the unit type to not disappear after moving the mouse cursor away from the unit portrait.
[*] Bug that caused the forced clan assimilation oath to not be fulfilled if a city was attacked with a clan.
[*] Freezing during game loading.
[*] After deleting a district from the construction queue, the required number of moves to build the next district was not displayed.
[*] Game freezing during an AI move when terminating the Right of Free Pass contract.
[*] Game freezing during the battle completion.
[*] Some interface bugs.
[*] A few visual bugs in the Japanese localization.
[/olist]
Also made easier-to-understand tooltips in the Science Tree. Now, when hovering over an item, there is a tooltip with the era in which it opens rather than the era in which the necessary resource for its creation opens. We made a change in the description of edicts. Now, if the radius of an edict is 0, the description displays 0, not the word “hex” as before.

We hope you are enjoying playing Revival: Recolonization. Share your impressions in the discussions and don't forget to write reviews.

Regards,
Revival: Recolonization Team

notes.title: Release date and the new Revival: Recolonization demo!
New Revival: Recolonization update!
notes.notes:
Greetings! 

Based on all of our players' feedback and wishes, we have prepared a brand new and robust update for Revival: Recolonization. We're going to tell you about all of these amazing changes.

We updated and refined the mini-tutorial so that it is better at guiding players along the optimal development path while providing up-to-date hints about the game.

And we have finalized the starting tutorial so that it teaches new players more about the gameplay and features. There is also a change of style for the dialogue and plot – Tania will find herself on another planet during the tutorial and then move to Earth.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_6eeed152626b464b934aa12d2c91a55e~mv2.gif[/img]

The important changes that will affect the overall dynamics of the game:
[list]
[*] Added the ability to skip animation during AI movement. This will reduce the waiting time during the enemy's turn.
[*] Optimized the AI algorithms to further reduce the waiting time during its turn.
[*] To speed up progress in the initial phase of the game, we tied the opening of several sciences to the clans' traits. Also, we fixed some logical errors, for example, for a clan with the trait “Merchants,” the science "Trade" was unexplored. Now, each of the three traits of the clan opens one of the sciences. After assimilation, the player gets a new trait and, at the same time, immediately opens the corresponding science, if it was not opened earlier. This allows you to develop faster, get more effective weapons, and move on to the next era. 
[*] Reduced the amount of damage when escaping from the battlefield. Previously, it was 50% and led to a slow down of map exploration during the early stages of the game. Now, the amount of damage will depend on the epoch: 20% damage on the first epoch, 30% damage on the second epoch, and 50% damage on the last two epochs.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/f5b250ae589b4c357aeb1335add6cf900f1a1518.png[/img]
Radically changed the system of edicts. They no longer need to be studied as sciences, but rather unlocked with the “Control Module.” The player obtains the Control Module when visiting any previously unexplored ruin. With the same control module, previously unlocked edicts can be strengthened.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_38ab0aaf95154d4780131024fb8bbfb8~mv2.gif [/img]
Interface:
[list]
[*] Added a button that allows you to rename a city.
[*] Added a notification to change the climate of a player's city if the hexes under the city blocks have a climate different from the clan's native climate.
[*] Changed the menu for creating new units. Previously, from the list of possible units, it was impossible to understand the difference between them at all. Replaced the text name of a unit with icons showing their armor. 
[*] Changed the “Empire Plans” window. It no longer needs to be explored. Empire plans options are available, depending on the player's current era. 
[*] Changed the diplomacy window with the clan, in particular the “Actions” tab. The oaths to the clan are placed on separate bars with buttons that say how much loyalty will add to this or that action. In previous versions of the game, oaths were in a drop-down list and were very invisible, but this is the main tool to influence loyalty. They also changed the size of some buttons and their location. “Assimilate” and “Vassalize” buttons are larger than the others, because these are the most important actions with the clan.
[/list]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_55bc3eda543b4b4793b9c519e76fb4ef~mv2.gif[/img]

Changed the principle of using the “Unit Editor.” It is no longer necessary to create unit types (templates), and the unit editor is used to upgrade a unit. The editor button has been removed from the top panel. 

At any time, you can click on the unit settings icon (gear) and see which parts it consists of. You can also change the weapon and apply this change if the treasury has enough resources for it, and if the unit is in your region. 

You can also use the unit editor in the city to customize the desired weapon, and then click the “Build” button, and the unit will begin construction.

Unfortunately, the old mobile phone version of Reviva will be removed from the game due to a conflict with antivirus programs. 

Korean and Japanese languages have also been added. 

Thank you for supporting our project and team. We are trying to make the game better and are already working on further improvements according to the roadmap. Share your impressions of the game in the comments and join our [url=https://discord.gg/92jBgJsvsD]Discord[/url]. 

Regards,
Revival: Recolonization Team

notes.title: The First Revival: Recolonization Patch
notes.notes:
Greetings! 

We want to thank all the players who have joined the Revival: Recolonization community. Your game impressions and feedback help us to find the game’s weak spots, improve gameplay and mechanics, and fix bugs. 

Here’s a patch that fixes several issues and enhances gameplay. 

[b]What's new: 
[/b]
1. The AI turn waiting time has been reduced by 40% in the early and mid-game phases. We plan to continue improving this aspect. 

2. You can now build as many Nexuses as you want. As Emperor Palpatine said, "UNLIMITED POWER!!!" 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/122e69828db9c56309653f1a18bb44e81ab3728d.png[/img]

3. Before the battle starts, the support squad's status is displayed in the accompanying window. If a squad has already participated in a battle in that turn, it will be displayed as inactive. So you can assess your available resources before the battle begins. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/b1306a32f7d44a79963d00c6630e6a9a64325913.png[/img]

4. We made the interaction with the Worker unit more understandable. The game interface did not clearly show the difference between inactive and active buildings that the unit can build when studying related science and having strategic resources on the hex with the Worker. Now, if the unit is on a hex where it cannot build a certain object, the corresponding buttons appear inactive. When you hover over them, a tooltip appears with an explanation. 

5. Now, after the Emissaries' recovery, their health is fully restored. The statuses received before death in battle are removed.

6. City districts are now built at the same level as the town hall (the city's central building). If your town hall is from the third era, all new city districts will be built at the third era level. 

7. Shields do not prevent the owner of the region from using edicts anymore. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/84be5b8313684c8fbf65622786a7a9673d12bffd.png[/img]

[b]The patch also makes some changes to the combat system. Specifically: 
[/b]
1. Archers can now retreat from enemies, without triggering the control zone. 
2. We increased the priority of the "Shield Bash" AI attack if it pushes a unit into the sea. However, "Shield Bash" no longer affects artillery and mobile troops (too heavy). 
3. We fixed a bug where ranged units received the "Electrified" status after being attacked by a unit with the "GMO: Shock Feedback". 
4. We made changes to the battle interface. Now, units that have already taken their turn in combat appear less noticeably on the menu panel than units that the player has not yet used. 
5. We fixed a bug where a unit with the "Frozen" status could attack and move under the influence of the "Mind Control" edict. 
6. Hotkeys are now available in combat. You can see them on the game’s settings screen. 
7. The turn automatically passes from the Emissary to another unit in battle only if the Emissary launches an edict. 
8. We limited the camera's distancing in a battle for a more optimal gaming experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/d42dc6b57c91a6f5416d790424e156e15d3218f7.png[/img]

[b]Based on your feedback, we made changes to the game interface: [/b]

1. We increased the tooltip display speed. For example, popup windows with hex climate type. 
2. Now, when you hover over a unit on the global map, the unit's description group window is always displayed. 
3. We updated the composition of the anomaly descriptions in their tooltip (a popup window that appears when hovering over it). Now, you can see immediately what effects the anomaly has on nearby hexes or regions. 
4. We updated the composition of edict descriptions - the impact on enemy squads in battle is now listed first. 
5. We fixed different icon sizes in science tooltips. 
6. We fixed the lack of changes when scaling the interface if applied in the main menu after a match. 

[b]
We also fixed other minor bugs and issues, including: [/b]

1. Inaccessibility of the city after building the Cathedral of Reconciliation. 
2. Inability to join a city from the Free Towns faction while having sufficient resources. 
3. Incorrect counting of the number of grown forests and bushes. Now, fires and high-to-low growth conversion do not affect it. 
4. The absence of a number on the resource exchange screen for "Edicts" and "Science" resources. 
5. The absence of a lock on the contract duration (increasing or decreasing) button when reaching the limit. 
6. The possibility to change the term in the contract offered by AI.
7. An issue when the construction queue in the city panel was not updated after destroying a district. 
8. Opening the edict screen by hotkey “C”, even if the unit has no moves left. 
9. The empire plans launching screen not closing after some other screens appears. 
10. We removed extraneous sounds in the tutorial intro video. 
11. We fixed incorrect music playback in the tutorial. 

Thanks a lot for supporting us in our 4X strategy game development path. 
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/pJ2YedmgcE]Discord[/url] and share your feedback on the game. 

Best regards, 
The Revival: Recolonization team.

notes.title: Pre-release Demo Is Here, PC Gamers!
notes.notes:
Greetings!
We have just opened the demo for the PC Gaming Show event, which we are proudly (a small) part of. You all are welcome to thoroughly try the game before its EA launch on the 28th of June 2023.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_91e7d6f739914519a0a04c47365a506d~mv2.gif [/img]

The Demo is the pre-final Revival: Recolonization experience and offers hours of gameplay without play-time or content restrictions. Some polishing will be applied to an Early Release though.

If you are new to our development journey, here is the run-down. Revival: Recolonization is a 4X game set on a post-apocalyptic Earth.  Players will lead a fledgling group of people as they rise up, improve their technologies and lead Humanity to glory and prosperity.
[list]
[*] Manipulate the terrain using the Edict System to give your army the edge in tactical battles.
[*] Customize your units the way you want to. Primeval warrior with high-tech gear? Sure, why not!
[*] Retake the Earth from the frantic AI that will make you face the consequences of your actions.
[/list] 
Play, share your feedback, tell your friends and your favorite let’s players about it. Don’t forget to wishlist the game and follow the Steam page not to miss the launch!

Regards,
Revival: Recolonization Team

notes.title: Enemy AI improved, new effects added, more changes to come!
notes.notes:
Greetings!

In today's post, we'll cover some of the upcoming changes and features for the game that we worked on over the past month.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/75b37216c9ba4d94f018482d165e89873ec22d62.jpg[/img]

There were further tweaks made to the AI to make sure that interactions with it are more interesting and dynamic. For example, in combat, the enemy can now target a single unit in order to bring it down more effectively. The AI will also make trade deals with clans to obtain the necessary materials needed to expand their empire or build new troop types. 

Some of the development time was devoted to working on animations and adjusting the visual effects in Revival: Recolonization.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_06a94c14be714307af76adb4139cff72~mv2.gif [/img]

In [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1306770/view/3377156325974715737]the last update[/url], we told you about the new drop pods that automatons will be using. And now we're ready to show off their landing animation. From the landing hex, the automatons will start moving towards the target region in order to punish any wrongdoers.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_6656df8465574270a51b92a3457c24c3~mv2.gif[/img] 

Animations were introduced for certain weapons that can fire single shots or in bursts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/f1bf21a0f8920111092f66c8fdf4fe20ac079a98.png[/img]

We also completed the monumental task of detailing the weapons in the hands of combat units. The differences between 3D models belonging to the same weapon class are now more noticeable.

Our team is also working on: 
[list]
[*] The game’s tutorial. A large number of game mechanics and systems makes this quite a daunting task =)
[*] UI refinement
[*] Art for the game’s intro cut-scene (let us know in the comments if you want a sneak peak).
[*] Game optimization.
[*] Making the mini-map more useful.
[/list]
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/92jBgJsvsD]official Discord[/url] server to chat about the game with other players and developers. We can't wait to see you!

Regards,
Revival: Recolonization Team

notes.title: Tribes and Clans Update Out Now!
Upcoming Tribe Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, associate!

Tribes have always been an important part of the Revival: Recolonization. In the upcoming update, our team wanted to expand on the idea of tribes and introduce more depth and replayability to this game system. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/3225ab2420f50a5134ee155e996e5b8801a615c2.jpg[/img]

As you may already know, there are currently 5 tribes in Revival. Each tribe has a predisposition to a certain climate type: Cold, Cool, Temperate, Hot and Desert. 

[list]
[*]Cultists of Eternal Ice. These wild savages and fearless warriors worship the Heavenly Liberator, bringing madness wherever they go. 
[*]Heresy Hunters. Fanatical warriors, defenders of subarctic lands from servants of the All-Mind and the barbarians from the icy wasteland.
[*]Children of the Vault. Descendants of the once civilized townspeople that survived the cataclysm in an underground bunker. They are not particularly strong in military affairs, but are always happy to rebuild civilization anew.
[*]Heavenly Fire Custodians. In the collective memories of these people, the cataclysm that struck Earth has etched itself in the form of a cleansing fire from the skies. Each tribesman views death by fire as an honour. 
[*]Ash Commissaries. Magistrates from the hot desert, protectors of trade caravans.
[/list]
Every tribe consists of a number of clans - separate settlements on the game map, each with their own chieftain. Each clan has three clan traits that determine its social composition and cultural values. When you pick a clan to lead, your faction inherits all three of its traits, as well as a unique trait of the tribe your chosen clan belongs to.

Your choice of clan at the beginning of the game influences how the game session will play out. To lead a bunch of desperate savages and cutthroats, or a peace-loving group of scientists and farmers – it is up to you to decide!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/6e1a645157cde0ab21a27dac1eaba4333adde8d3.png[/img]

By assimilating clan after clan, your faction will be able to gain new traits, becoming more and more unique in the process. 

Clan traits are distributed randomly when the game world is generated. However, there are a few limitations related to a clan’s tribe alignment.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/344486fb6e5fa7aaa2c7dab280bea20bf9561514.jpg[/img]

For example, clans belonging to the Children of the Vault tribe cannot have the “savages'' trait, since members of this tribe tend to be more technologically savvy than others. Ash Commissaries clans cannot have the "murderer" or "thief" traits, since they go against the tribe’s cultural and philosophical views. 

The Tribe Update will be launching in the next 1-2 weeks, depending on how QA goes. Get ready to immerse yourself in the intricacies of tribes and clans coming to Revival!

Yours faithfully,
Revival: Recolonization Team

notes.title: Game build updated! Bug fixes and other improvements
AI Combat Update: Man vs. Machine
notes.notes:
Greetings, associate!

Our team is continuously working to improve and refine the combat system in Revival: Recolonization. A great deal has changed over the past few months, as we were busy implementing and testing new mechanics. Today, we are going to talk about one of the most important aspects of combat: enemy AI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/6c962aa6538cd94aab6ea6f327b073befc4f7da3.jpg[/img]

In most turn-based strategy games, the AI is programmed to attack the player in a mostly straightforward manner using a basic set of skills. This tends to make the enemy's strategy predictable, leading to easy victories for the player. Creativity is what differentiates human players from AI — the inability to think outside of the box and make battles interesting.

To combat this issue, we decided on a chess-like system, where both the player and the AI use their limited number of units in the most constructive ways possible. Of course, they also need to take into account battlefield conditions, unit loadouts, and armor ratings. 

Players will no longer face treacherous full-frontal attacks from suicidal AI units. Instead, the AI will carefully choose when and where to attack the player. From the AI's first turn, it will assign a "weight" value to each hex and action, then follow through with an appropriate strategy. These values will be unique for each unit. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245204/66f451106e44a5f648a33b63b2459374eb0ad076.jpg[/img]

We've also ‘taught’ the combat AI to understand battle conditions. For example, enemy AI will know that units on fire can be extinguished by standing on a hex with water. You're probably thinking that you can use this to your advantage and lead the AI into a deadly ambush, but you'd be wrong. The AI managed to surprise even us by showing an ability to set its own traps. It's also learned to use environmental elements and combine them with rarely used skills. 

During testing, this unexpected behavior proved decisive to the AI's victory. Thus, we are also experimenting with different combat difficulties in order to allow players of any experience and skill level to enjoy this aspect of the game.

It's important to understand that the combat AI uses the same data that's available to players. There is no hidden information and both the player and the AI are on equal footing. When armies are matched in terms of strength and composition, human creativity and a cunning strategy can turn the tides of battle.

Be ready to test your mettle and combat chops in the Open Alpha!

[b]Respectfully,
Revival: Recolonization Team[/b]
